narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the repository structure.
finalText:
**Big but mechanical: 1,266 hits, 94 files.**

Shape is 25 entity triples across 5 services. Most hits are plain locals. Rename those freely.

Five zones must not change:

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [`migrations/*.sql`](migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql:9) | 36 | Applied in prod |
| repo `sql:` strings | 125 | Real DB column |
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk`](vendor/reporting-sdk/README.md:3) | 20 | `vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | 5 | Public contract |
| [`lib/serialize.js`](lib/serialize.js:8) WIRE value | 2 | Public wire name |

Two more are coupled. `req.session.account_id` hits 100 sites. The payload JSONB key hits 25.

Next: split the sign-off. Approve the ~950 locals. Hold the rest.
